en.askTitle: Fill in your own visa, suburb and budget, and get the same checked launch plan for tutoring in Auckland
en.runTitle: A former maths teacher from Chennai starting NCEA and Cambridge tutoring in Mount Roskill, Auckland, from February 2027

fields.label: Visa conditions and expiry
fields.value: Partner work visa with open work rights; husband holds an Accredited Employer Work Visa

fields.label: Teaching credentials and syllabus strengths
fields.value: Former high-school maths teacher from Chennai; NCEA and Cambridge

fields.label: Suburb and home-use constraints
fields.value: Mount Roskill, Auckland, at home and online

fields.label: Realistic weekly availability
fields.value: Aiming for 20 paid hours a week by mid-2027

fields.label: Platform to compare
fields.placeholder: e.g. a tutor-listing site you are considering

en.template: Help me plan solo maths tutoring in Auckland for {launch}. My visa conditions and expiry are {visa}, teaching credentials and syllabus strengths {credentials}, suburb/home-use constraints {suburb}, budget {budget} and realistic weekly availability {hours}. Check visa and tutor-registration gaps, compare direct referrals with {platform}, stress-test paid hours and tax/ACC cash, and prepare parent terms, safeguarding and privacy steps. Keep home visits conditional and ask before contacting anyone, posting, sharing pupil information or applying.

phases.title: Read the official rules on visas, tutor checks, tax and ACC, and collect dated Auckland rates and platform fees
phases.note: Immigration, Police vetting, child safety and privacy, IRD and ACC, and real tutor adverts
phases.judgment: It treated the six tutor adverts as examples, not evidence of a market: all were undated, and they were not six verified tutors. It also threw out early page fetches that had silently gone through an already-open browser and re-read the sources plainly, saying so in the notes.

phases.title: Write the guide and the money model, with every source listed
phases.note: Recommendation first, rate and platform-fee tables, pricing, schedule and a first-year income and tax table

phases.title: Recheck every claim and number with a separate reviewer, and test the desktop and phone layouts
phases.judgment: The reviewer ran 49 separate arithmetic checks and all passed, but the report still spells out what is unresolved: undated adverts, whether tutor registration rules apply, several platform fees. The NZ$31,081.60 first-year surplus stays labelled as conditional.

workers: Checked what her partner work visa allows, whether tutors need a Police vet or registration, and the child-safety and privacy rules
Read the official IRD and ACC guidance for sole-trader tutoring: GST threshold, provisional tax and levies
Collected public Auckland maths tutor rates and platform fees, noting which adverts are undated
Independently reviewed the finished guide: recomputed every money figure and checked claims against the source list
